sentences.en: I am happy today.
She is sad because her dog is sick.
sentences.zh: 她很难过因为她的狗生病了。

sentences.en: He is angry about the broken window.
sentences.zh: 他对打破的窗户很生气。

sentences.en: I love my family very much.
She has a fear of the dark.
I hope to see you again.
I like this song.
I hate the taste of bitter medicine.
The music gives me pleasure.
I have a pain in my tooth.
The baby cries because he is hungry.
We all laugh at the funny story.
sentences.zh: 我们都因这个有趣的故事而大笑。

sentences.en: Are you afraid of the dog?
I do not feel well today.
I felt anger when he broke my toy.
sentences.zh: 他弄坏我的玩具时我感到愤怒。

sentences.en: The violent wind damaged the house.
I have a feeling of disgust for the dirty food.
sentences.zh: 我对肮脏的食物感到厌恶。

sentences.en: She cried with regret.
The shock of the cold water made me jump.
sentences.zh: 冷水的冲击让我跳了起来。

sentences.en: Do not shake the bottle.
She felt shame for her bad behavior.
sentences.zh: 她为自己不好的行为感到羞愧。

sentences.en: I have doubt about his story.
The fear of heights made her shake.
sentences.zh: 对高度的恐惧让她颤抖。

sentences.en: I have a strong belief in being kind.
My happiness comes from being with my family.
sentences.zh: 我的快乐来自和家人在一起。

sentences.en: I have an interest in learning new things.
sentences.zh: 我对学习新事物有兴趣。
